# Chart.js

Pinned Chart.js **4.5.1** UMD distribution, self-hosted for the cooperation overview's doughnut charts. Loaded only when the summary is rendered.

- Distribution: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.5.1/dist/chart.umd.min.js
- Upstream: https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js/tree/v4.5.1
- License: MIT; see `chart-LICENSE.md`.

The library is unmodified. The optional source map is not included.
